balls.text: full ball, following Malinga who had backed away from the stumps, the ball sneaks between the batsman and the stumps, goes through to the keeper, batsmen don't go for the bye
a low full ball on the pads, squeezed out towards the leg side for a quick single
length ball this time, Mitchell Johnson can hit them big as he does here, launching it over long-on for six
a full toss outside off, Johnson swings and misses
slower ball, on a length, a one-handed swipe from Harbhajan and that is taken at midwicket by Saurabh Tiwary
length ball on leg stump, swiped towards midwicket for a single
back of a length ball on leg stump, clipped behind square leg for four
shot! when in form Harbhajan can hit as cleanly as anyone, that was a length ball from RP, slammed over the bowler's head for four
full toss way outside off, punched towards cover, Kohli on the prowl again, another direct hit and he would have had another run-out, he misses this time
eased towards mid-off for a single
short of length ball on leg stump, helped along to the deep backward square leg boundary
length ball on the pads, eased towards deep midwicket for a couple

terrific fielding from Rampaul at short third man, a full ball outside off from Vinay, squeezed down towards short third, diving stop there from Rampaul, who has been superb in the field all innings, just two off the over
length ball swinging away a touch, past the outside edge and through to the keeper, what an over this turning out to be from Vinay

a team hat-trick for RCB, the danger man Pollard departs now, a short ball that Pollard looks to pull, top edges it and the ball swirls towards third man, Rampaul does well to collect that one, Vinay roars in delight, Mumabi losing their way

full and outside off, and has Kohli done it again?, Pollard punches the ball towards extra cover once more, Kohli is onto it once more and another direct hit hands Rayudu a diamond duck, Rayudu was looking to get back in the crease after taking a start, Vinay was in the way though, as he was backing away from the stumps to collect the throw, Rayudu's bat is lifted off the ground after it collides with Vinay's leg, he hasn't made it back into the crease, and he is sent on his way, not intentional from Vinay, tough luck for Rayudu

full and outside off, sensational bit of fielding from Kohli, Karthik thought  he had an easy single there after punching the ball towards mid-off, Kohli sprints across to his right and fires in a direct hit, Karthik has given up towards the end, and his innings ends on 42
starts the over with a full toss, escapes with only a single, Pollard sends that towards midwicket, AB cuts it off
full and wide outside off, Pollard powers that towards sweeper cover, Pollard happy with a single
on the pads with fine leg in the circle, that's a poor line, easy put away to the backward square leg boundary
good bouncer from RP Singh, testing Pollard who goes for the pull but doesn't connect
another massive hit, RP searching for the yorker but provides a length ball, launched for six over long-on

full ball outside off, Pollard power! that is drilled past long-off for four, that wasn't even off the middle of the bat, not quite an edge but off the inside half of the bat, still that travelled with serious haste
short of length and down the leg side
an inside-edge as the batsman looks to hoick that towards midwicket, it was a length ball from RP, lucky to get away with that
full ball outside off, driven towards long-off for a single, eight off the over
a bouncer outside off, Karthik can't put this one away either, terrific comeback in this over by Vinay
full ball just outside off, Karthik can't get under that one
outside off and he can't get bat on that
full and wide, too wide outside off
short of length ball, Karthik charges down and mistimes a lofted hit, but he has picked his spot, mid-off is in the circle, easily clears the fielder

another massive six, Pollard showing off his hitting skills, this was a monster hit, easily clears the rope, lands way beyond long-on, fasten your seatbelts folks! the next five overs promises to be fun
short of length ball on the pads, clipped towards midwicket
length ball on the pads, helped down to short fine leg, lucky for the bowler there, a bit of placement on that, and it was a boundary
short of length ball is whipped towards midwicket for a quick two, there's a chance of an overthrow but both batsmen had overrun
whipped away towards midwicket for two more
massive! a length ball and Pollard hits that a mile into the air and plenty of rows behind long-off, didn't seem to put much effort in that either
drops it short, Karthik goes for the pull, doesn't connect perfectly, the ball lands short of the midwicket rope and then rolls over for four
a short ball aimed at the body, Pollard was looking to duck, then thrusts his bat at it, off the handle towards square leg, good over this from Unadkat
blocked off the front foot, Pollard shows us his defensive technique
short of length ball that sneaks between the bat and pad, Pollard was looking to defend that off the front foot
guides that one down towards third man for a single
Unadkat bowls it on a length on middle and leg, defended down the track
eased towards sweeper cover for a single

a run-out! full and outside off, powered towards wide long-off, Karthik initially wanted the second, took a few paces, Rohit Sharma started to sprint for it, Karthik stopped and screamed for Rohit to turn back, it was too late though for Rohit, and he is run-out, Rohit throws his bat to the ground in frustration
an inside-edge sends the ball towards fine leg for a single
a length ball is swatted away wide of long-on for four, just a s you thought things were getting a bit quiet, Karthik muscles a boundary
length ball is driven towards long-on, a bit of an inside edge there, Rohit was looking to send the ball towards long-off
guided towards cover for a single
short of length ball just outside off, dabbed down to third man by Karthik, who has been somewhat subdued so far today
slapped towards Tiwary at deep midwicket
short of length ball outside off, Rohit chases after that and the extra bounce takes the ball past the bat, a muted appeal for caught-behind
short of length ball on off stump, is poked towards cover for a single
terrific delivery there, just outside off, has Karthik feeling for it, beaten by that one
Rampaul starts his spell with a length ball on the pads, Rohit gets bat on it and the ball dribbles behind square leg
short of length ball is clipped towards midwicket for two more
short of length ball sliding straight on, another single to the leg side
length ball on legstump, defended towards square leg for a single
on the pads, clipped towards midwicket for a single
flighted length ball outside off, what a terrific start from Rohit, a classy front-foot drive through cover for four, brings up Mumbai's 100 as well
Smith is gone, Syed Mohammed strikes, it was a short ball, it was flat and fast, Smith was looking to hammer it over midwicket, he misses and that crashes into the stumps
on the pads, clipped past square leg for a couple, Mumbai flying along, 97 for 1 after 10
Smith shuffles away from the stumps and opens the face to guide the ball towards third man for a single that brings up his half-century, taken only 35 balls, that too after a pretty slow start
a length ball just outside off, helped along with the angle towards third man
a bouncer from Unadkat, Karthik sways out of the line
outside off and that is stabbed towards point, again some confused calling, Karthik wanted one, Smith didn't, the throw from Dilshan was wide of the stumps and they pinched an onverthrow
Smith taking full toll of the small boundaries at the Wankhede, this was a length ball that is muscled from off stump to the midwicket boundary for six
short of length ball just outside off, driven towards sweeper cover, pushes for the second, 19 off the over
a stifled lbw appeal as the ball was slanting down the leg side, Smith is caught on the crease but that hit high on the pad and would have sailed over as well
one of the flattest sixes of the season! Smith going bonkers here, it wasn't too short either, still Smith pulls it away with tremendous power to the square leg boundary
pitched up and curling away from the batsman, who looks to power it through the cover but is beaten
Vinay goes short, Smith expected it, he waits on the back foot and pummels that past midwicket for four, this short-arm pull is one of his favourite shots, and he gets plenty of power on it
length ball, Smith doesn't bother much with his footwork as he slams that over the bowler's head for six
a clean hit towards long-on, one bounce before reaching the fielder

nearly a run-out, major confusion there, Smith played the ball towards backward point, Karthik wanted a single, Smith sends him back, the throw isn't the best from the fielder, Unadkat collects and hits the stumps but Karthik's dive gets him to safety
a slower one from Unadkat, Smith is surprised by that one, beaten outside off
guided to short third, no time to get a run
defended to the off side for a quick single

oh my goodness, how did that go all the way for six, Karthik was looking to pull that one but he gets a top edge, the ball goes real high and you thought that was going to drop short of the rope, instead it sails over for a 64m six
fired in, short ball and heading for the pads, clipped towards midwicket for a couple
keeps it full, punched towards long-off for one more
angling in towards middle and leg, driven to mid-on for one more
played with soft hands, tapped towards cover for a single
full ball on middle, pushed towards mid-on for a single
the first ball of spin turns in towards the stumps, slapped towards point for a single
just after I say that, Smith plays a lovely drive through the covers for four, waits for it and just guides it past cover, and Mumbai's fifty comes up
a mistimed lofted drive over mid-off for a couple, Smith clearly not at his best here
short of length ball just outside off, Smith looks to push towards cover and is beaten, Smith is unhappy at that weak attempt at a shot
good comeback from Vinay, a bouncer that takes off, Smith goes for the hook but that is too good for him, and too high for the leaping keeper as well
slants it into the pads, rubbish delivery when you have fine leg in the circle, easily glanced for four
length ball heading for the pads, defended to the leg side from the crease
Smith gets forward and looks to push the ball towards mid-off, edges it instead to the leg side for a single
short of length ball angling across, slapped towards point by Smith, can't find the gap
short ball that sits up for Smith, a muscular swat sends the ball to the square-leg boundary for four, poor delivery form Unadkat
length ball on middle and off, tapped towards AB at cover, taking him on once more, that was a tight single
that pitches outside leg and Karthik looks to clip the ball to the leg side but is struck on the pads
a mistimed flat-batted slap towards extra cover from Smith
terrific diving stop from Vinay Kumar at mid-on, Smith played another of his ungainly swats, seemed headed for four till Vinay intervened

short of length ball that swerves back in towards Karthik, who somehow manages to get bat on that one, the ball rolls towards cover, AB swoops in on it and chucks the ball towards the stumps, Smith was out of his ground but the throw is just wide

the end of Sachin's innings, the crowd don't like it, Tendulkar moved across the stumps looking to clip the ball to the leg side, that pitched on middle and leg and curved in, past Tendulkar's bat and is struck on the pads, just above the knee roll, Tendulkar gone for a 13-ball 23
Tendulkar is drawn towards that delivery that is angling away from him, he chases it and misses
short of length ball outside off, Tendulkar shuffles across and looks to tuck the ball to the leg side, he misses and is struck on the pad just outside off
an ugly swipe from Smith towards mid-on for a single, bringing back SRT on strike
four fours in the over for SRT, the volume in the Wankhede goes way up, this was the best shot of the lot, moving across the stumps and helps along a legstump delivery down to fine leg
short of length ball is swatted away past midwicker for four, not exactly off the middle of the bat but he gets another boundary, Tendulkar in top gear
length ball outside off and that is launched over mid-off for four by Tendulkar, he has been looking to go for his shots right from the start, coming off so far
short ball outside off, Tendulkar gets his front leg out of the way to try swipe the ball, but it was too wide outside off for that
length ball moving away a touch, 138.8kph, defended towards cover off the front foot
length ball outside off, bit of width there, Tendulkar bends his knees as he goes after it, launches it over point, a couple of bounces for four
extra bounce for RP there, hit high on the bat as Smith defends to the off side
curving in towards the pads once more, Smith is cramped up but squeezes it towards fine leg, Ravi Rampaul chases from short fine and makes a terrific diving save
shapes in towards the pads, an lbw appeal but Smith is safe

Tendulkar having a difficult time of it here, a short ball from RP, Tendulkar was on the front foot, takes his eyes off the ball, and that hits him on the glove as he fends at it, sad to see SRT surprised by an RP Singh bouncer
on the pads once more, this time it isn't down the leg side, off the pads towards midwicket for a leg-bye
swings it down the leg side
RP Singh swings it in towards the pads, defended to the leg side
a leading edge this time, the ball rolls back towards the bowler, terrific opening over from Rampaul

Tendulkar escapes, a swinging delivery outside off from Rampaul, Tendulkar chases after it, gets on one knee as he looks to drive it, takes the outside edge and it flies between keeper and first slip, Wankhede holds its breath for a second and then roars in glee
Tendulkar nearly loses his balance as he leans over to tuck a length ball from middle towards square leg
length ball just outside off, eased towards deep backward point for a single
Smith looks to flay the next one through cover and he toe-ends it towards the fielder, think the bat is broken, yup, he gets a new one
what a ripper first up to start from Rampaul, back of a length ball swerves away and is far too good for Smith, who is beaten
and a bouncer that Vinay can't get bat on finishes off the game, Mumbai win by 58 runs
full ball outside off is carved behind point for four
short of length ball is slapped towards midwicket
a high full toss is slapped towards long-on, too high from Smith
full ball is powered back towards the bowler, who can't collect cleanly and allows a single
short of length ball is defended towards cover for a single
a length ball is powered wide of long-on for four more, all helping reduce the margin of defeat
clubbed! a full ball is hammered to the left of the bowler and the right of mid-off for four, a powerful hit that
a mistimed swipe sends the ball towards long-on
a low full toss, a comical swipe from Rampaul sends the ball towards long-on
short ball is pulled away to the square leg boundary, one-bounce four for Rampaul
a misfield by Ojha at long-on allows an extra run, is that his only contribution of the match?
short of length ball is slapped towards midwicket
full and well outside off, squeezed towards backward point where Pollard is lurking
full and outside off, Rampaul can't get bat on it
short and wide outside off, slapped towards sweeper cover
a yorker from Dhawal, nearly sneaks through, just about defended by Vinay
slapped towards point this time, short and wide outside off
pitched up and that is punched towards cover for a single
shortish ball down the leg side, Vinay skips away from the stumps and powers that towards cow corner for four
short of length ball angling across, left alone
a crisp hit towards mid-on
shortish ball on off stump, that was a run-out chance, Dwayne Smith missed though, Vinay defended towards point, Rampaul wanted one, Vinay didn't, Rampaul was a long way out if that had hit
angling into the pads, a leg-bye to square leg
short of length ball on leg stump, defended for a single
a yorker on leg stump, Rampaul does well to get his feet out of the way and defend the ball
a low full toss just outside off, Rampaul makes room and hits that over extra cover for four
a full toss outside off, a thin outside edge, ball bounces through to the keeper
backs away from the stumps, a full ball is sent towards third man by Vinay
a short ball hits Rampaul on the arm, it was superbly directed, Rampaul couldn't duck under, or drops his wrists to get out of the way
Malinga returns with a yorker, defended towards midwicket
a bouncer from Pollard, the batsman ducks under
Pollard bowls from well behind the stumps, eased to deep backward square
short of length ball outside off, guided down to third man for one more, Rampaul and Polard exchange some good-natured banter
outside edge down to third man for a single
short of length ball is eased to the off side for a single
short of length ball is slapped towards point
short of length ball outside off, guided down to third man for four, RCB 89 for 7, first target is getting to three figures
another wicket for Smith, Syed goes for the pull, a top-edge and Mitchell Johnson takes another smart catch at third man, Mumbai closing in on a dominant victory
huge appeal for lbw, but that looked to be missing off
on the pads, helped towards deep square leg
another ungainly slog from Tiwary, top-edges it to long-on, Mr 1.6million walks back
full ball is thumped down the ground, get back for a second
a full toss which should have been put away, mistimed by Tiwary towards mid-off
defended to the leg side for a single

an lbw appeal, but it is turned down as that was going down the leg side, Tiwary charged out for a single though the striker hadn't budged, Tiwary had to turn around and speed back, a direct hit would have had him short
flighted delivery is defended to the off side
tapped towards midwicket for a single
defended to the off side by Tiwary
a full ball just outside off, too good for the batsman
slower ball, on a length, guided towards backward point
a short ball is slugged towards midwicket, a misfield allows an extra run
length ball on the pads, helped down to fine leg for a single
length ball outside off, terrific shot from Syed Mohammed, eases it past point for four
a low full toss on middle, whipped towards midwicket
stays on the back foot and looks to nudge the ball towards square leg, misses and is struck on the pads
another hoick from Tiwary, towards deep square leg for a single
length ball on off stump, punched towards long-off

terrific effort from Dinesh Karthik, who dismissed Arun Karthik with an athletic bit of keeping, Karthik had no clue where the ball was after trying to run the ball down towards fine leg, it pitched and spun towards the keeper, Arun Karthik started going for the single, Dinesh Karthik had the ball in his hand, break the stumps and that's another one down for RCB
cross-batted swipe to a length ball outside off, he misses
short of length ball, defended to the off side
a short ball and that is hooked away for six by Arun Karthik, many of us think this game is over, clearly Karthik doesn't
short of length, defended to the off side by Tiwary
miles down the leg side from Kulkarni
short ball is pulled away towards midwicket, I think Saurabh Tiwary's pull is one of the ugliest shots in world cricket, but it seems to work for him
defended to the off side this time

that was a run-out there, Kulkarni had plenty of time , but he was in a hurry to let the ball go, Tiwary defended the ball to the left of the bowler, Arun Karthik raced out of his crease, and was caught out a long way from safety, the throw was wide
short of length ball, punched towards long-on for a single
struck on the pads but that was going down the leg side
bottom-edges it past the keeper, almost ran away for four, but Tendulkar pulls it back just short of the rope
not as cleanly struck this time, bounces through to Mitchell Johnson at long-on
skips down the track and launches that over Harbhajan Singh's head for six, cleanly struck
length ball on the pads, clipped towards midwicket for a single
length ball outside off, eased behind backward point, 2-0-7-3, with wickets of Dilshan, Kohli and AB, it's a dream game for Dhawal
and nearly another edge through to the keeper, Arun Karthik was beaten by that one outside off

this is going to end in an embarrassing defeat for RCB, now AB de Villiers is gone, another edge through to the keeper, again a hint of away movement does the job, Dhawan Kulkarni in his first game of the season is asking the Mumbai Indian selectors," How on earth did you keep me out this long?"
defended this time for a single
a bouncer down the leg side to greet Tiwary, past the keeper and Mitchell does well at the boundary to stop it for going over the rope
RCB imploding here, Kohli is gone, a short of length ball moves away a touch, Kohli chases after it and he tickles it through to the keeper, can't see RCB winning this now
length ball is eased towards sweeper cover for a single
almost a return catch to Harbhajan, just wide of the bowler

there's the wicket, it's a superb catch by Ambati Rayudu, he 's off celebrating as if he's just won the World Cup, Wankhede is jubilant, it was top-edged towards wide long-on by Gayle, it was in the air for a long while, Rayudu had to pedal backwards to get under it, he collects it a couple of paces from the rope, but the momentum takes him ever closer to the boundary, he manages to balance himself before touching the rope, and then sets off a celebratory run
length ball around off stump, worked towards deep midwicket
Gayle waits on the back foot, punches the ball towards long-off
defended again, again some turn for Harbhajan, this time Gayle plays it to point
spins away from a length, defended towards slip by Gayle
short of length ball outside off, slapped toward cover, ends an over that only yielded one run
short of length ball outside off, left alone by Kohli

there's the wicket, Dilshan has had a horrid IPL season, and it continues today, a length ball outside off, a thick outside edge sends the ball flying towards Mitchell Johnson at third man, well held by him, a sliding take, and Dilshan's innings is over
too wide outside off stump
short ball from Kulkarni, 140.5kph bouncer that, Dilshan can't get bat on ball for the third ball in a row
short of length and well outside off, Dilshan chases for it and misses
first ball is short of length outside off, Dilshan looks to hammer it but is beaten
short of length ball outside off, a thick edge sends the ball flying past backward point and through to the boundary
an ugly hoick attempted by Gayle, and he misses, not a common sight this, it was back of a length and outside off
there's what Gayle can do, it was a full ball from Johnson, launched over the bowler's head, terrible timing but the ball still nearly carries all the way to the boundary

terrific delivery from Johnson, outstanding bowling here, swinging away after pitching on a length, just outside off and Gayle's beaten, he was stuck on the back foot there, perhaps expecting more short stuff
that one swings in towards Dilshan, who looks to thrash the ball towards the leg side, gets an inside-edge towards square leg
full and wide outside off, slapped towards cover but can't get the placement right
a yorker on off stump to complete the over, a terrific one from Malinga, showing why he is one of the best T20 bowlers around, superb accuracy, tying down Gayle
a bouncer from Malinga, sensational bowling from Mumbai here, Gayle isn't sure how to play that one, he fends at it and is struck on the left shoulder
a low full toss just outside off, Gayle looks to open the face and guide it to third man, again not a stroke you see often from Gayle, he misses
slower ball, smart from Malinga, short of length bal, Gayle defends it back to the bowler
Malinga goes for the yorker, it was a low full toss on off stump, swiped towards the leg side
a full toss from Malinga outside off, Dilshan can't time it properly but has enough on it to clear mid-off
short again, 138.7kph, the bouncer beats Gayle and it rises so high that the keeper can't get a hand on it either, results in four byes, good over from Johnson, though 12 came off it
Gayle goes for the big mow and he completely misses it, it was a shortish ball from Johnson outside off, Mumbai have decided to keep it short against Gayle here, it's working so far
a cracking drive from Dilshan, can't beat mid-off though

ooh, just out of reach of slips, Gayle nearly dismissed there! it was a short ball outside off, Gayle looked to ramp it over the slips, it is off the gloves and loops up, both slips chase after it but the ball is just out of their reach, not a shot  you'd see Gayle play often
length ball results in a leading edge, but it lands safe

the Gayle storm begins, he moved away from the stumps, Johnson followed him, didn't give him much room, still Gayle managed toswat that away to midwicket, he was exactly in position to play that shot, but Gayle doesn't care, goes through with the shot and that is over the rope
shortish ball outside off, dragged by Dilshan wide of mid-on for four, not the best timed of strokes but enough power behind it to get a boundary
short of length ball on off stump, slapped towards cover point
and another miss, Dilshan gets forward to a short of length ball just outside off, the ball snakes away a touch and beats Dilshan
no feet from Dilshan as he swings and misses at a ball outside off
a short of length ball that Dilshan wanted to send over midwicket, a leading edge sends the ball to the off side
back of a length ball on legstump, defended to the leg side for a single
full and outside off, Dilshan doesn't move his feet as he tries to get bat on that one, he can't, though to the keeper
Dilshan gets going with a cracking drive past extra cover for four, it was pitched up by Johnson, put away by Dilshan
full ball on the pads, punched towards mid-on

full ball outside off, the ball is defended to the right of the bowler, there was no run there, Dilshan knows it, he takes a couple of paces before casually turning back, Johnson fires in a direct hit, Mumbai think they have Dilshan run out, but he is back in the crease
short of length ball on the pads, clipped behind square leg for a single
short of a length ball outside off, defended towards point by Gayle
